verdict.rationale: Appwrite's first-party docs say it was 'designed from the ground up with self-hosting in mind' and runs on any OS with a Docker CLI, with one-click marketplace deployments and full control over data location. The CLI supports self-hosted endpoints and migrations work between Cloud and self-hosted. A community user praises the self-hosting guide, and the llms.txt probe confirms the product is described as open source. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of feature parity between self-hosted and Cloud (e.g., whether newer dedicated PostgreSQL/compute features are available self-hosted), and more recent hands-on corroboration.
